  "router_body":   [94, 110, 128, 255],
  "router_dark":   [62, 74, 92, 255],
  "router_led":    [46, 139, 87, 255],
--- mode table keys (verified by parsing data/palette.json):
deutan ['coast', 'ghost_bad', 'ghost_ok', 'house_roofs', 'lane_best_effort', 'lane_express', 'lane_standard', 'packet_classes', 'park', 'pipe_copper', 'pipe_fiber', 'pipe_steel', 'route_glow', 'route_tie', 'state_congested', 'state_critical', 'state_healthy', 'water']
detail: Spec-7-3 frozen Always clause: 'Every mode restyles ALL of the view: state triad, lanes, ghost, roofs/host/router tones, packet class colors...'. host_body/host_roof/router_body/router_dark/router_led keep canon values under every mode.

title: S cannot close the settings panel while a pipe is selected — panel footer 'S / tap chip to close' is false in that state (carried since r2 W3, unfixed at this sha)
detail: The collection gate checks sel_pipe<0 with no panel_open exception, so the advertised keyboard close is dead exactly when a pipe is selected (chip tap and pad B still close). Spec I/O matrix row 'Panel opens mid-run' implies symmetric close behavior.
recommended_fix: Collect S for panel-close whenever panel_open (gate sel_pipe only on the open direction), or correct the footer copy.

title: Settings chip hit-test is live at Game_Over where chip/panel never draw — a mouse/touch click opens an INVISIBLE modal that routes pad A to a disk-persisting adjust (carried r3 warning, unfixed)
location: app/main.odin:1052-1071 (early return) vs app/main.odin:1235 (chip draw) + app/main.odin:809-817 (effect_ui_press)
detail: on_ui_press is not mode-gated: a click/tap on the invisible chip rect at Game_Over sets panel_open; pad A then becomes Settings_Activate (adjust + settings_save) with no visual. Spec: 'settings I/O app-side with defaults fallback' is honored, but the panel surface contradicts the Game_Over terminal-screen contract.
recommended_fix: Gate settings_click's open path (or the on_ui_press wiring) on mode != .Game_Over, or draw the chip at Game_Over.

title: AUDIO row is never persisted though effect_settings_adjust claims 'Every change lands in ... the settings file' — settings format has no mute byte (carried since r2 W7, unfixed)
detail: The panel presents AUDIO as a settings row but mute resets on relaunch — the persisted-settings surface the spec/user ruling established covers only 3 of the 4 rows; the comment overstates the contract.
recommended_fix: Persist the mute byte (bump SETTINGS_VERSION) or fix the comment and the panel's persistence implication.

title: Phase-1 key buffer is [10]Key but 12 keys are collectible (P, Space, D, T, M, S, Up, Down, Left, Right, Enter, Esc) — a same-frame chord silently drops keys (carried since r2, now worse)
evidence:
keys: [10]Key
--- collected cases (read from mouse.odin 60-110):
case .P, .Space: / case .D: / case .T: / case .M: / case .S: / case .Up, .Down, .Left, .Right, .Enter: / case .Esc:
detail: 12 distinct keys can be collected into a 10-slot buffer; overflow is a silent drop (each case guards `if keys_n < len(keys)`). Absurd chord required, but the 7.3 nav keys widened the surface.
recommended_fix: Grow the buffer to cover all collectible keys or assert on overflow.

title: parse_mode_table sets roofs_set before validating elements — a malformed house_roofs entry yields BLACK roofs, not the spec's base-palette fallback (carried since r1, unfixed)
detail: Spec I/O matrix: 'palette.json mode table malformed | palette_load | base palette fallback (jcol precedent)'. A non-array element leaves that roof at the jcol_arr default black while roofs_set=true applies the table.
recommended_fix: Validate all 4 elements parse before setting roofs_set; skip the token otherwise.
